mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ssm_portal_dynamic_report ( report_id, version, menu_id, portal_id, parent_menu_id, report_name, oss_url, resource_url, file_ext, report_type, index_path, published_by, published_time, is_active, created_by, created_time ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{version}, #{menuId}, #{portalId}, #{parentMenuId}, #{reportName}, #{ossUrl}, #{resourceUrl}, #{fileExt}, #{reportType}, #{indexPath}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedTime}, 1, #{createdBy}, NOW() )

SELECT t.report_id AS reportId, t.version AS version, t.menu_id AS menuId, t.portal_id AS portalId, t.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, t.report_name AS reportName, t.oss_url AS ossUrl, t.resource_url AS resourceUrl, t.file_ext AS fileExt, t.report_type AS reportType, t.index_path AS indexPath, t.published_by AS publishedBy, t.published_time AS publishedTime, t.is_active AS isActive, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.created_time AS createdTime, t.updated_by AS updatedBy, t.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM ssm_portal_dynamic_report t INNER JOIN ( SELECT report_id, MAX(version) AS max_version FROM ssm_portal_dynamic_report WHERE portal_id = #{portalId} AND is_active = 1 GROUP BY report_id ) lv ON t.report_id = lv.report_id AND t.version = lv.max_version WHERE t.portal_id = #{portalId} AND t.is_active = 1 ORDER BY t.published_time DESC
